+		return false
+	}
+	otherCH, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c.disable != otherCH.disable || c.hasConsistentHash != otherCH.hasConsistentHash {
+		return false
+	}
+	if (c.sourceIP == nil) != (otherCH.sourceIP == nil) {

+		}
+	}
+	if len(c.headers) != len(otherCH.headers) ||
+		len(c.cookies) != len(otherCH.cookies) ||
+		len(c.queryParameters) != len(otherCH.queryParameters) ||
+		len(c.filterState) != len(otherCH.filterState) {

+		}
+	}
+	for i := range c.queryParameters {

+		}
+	}
+	for i := range c.filterState {

+	}

+	}
+	for _, h := range c.headers {
+		if h.HeaderName == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("headerName must not be empty")
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			if h.RegexRewrite.Pattern == "" {
+				return fmt.Errorf("regex rewrite pattern must not be empty")
+			}
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.RegexRewrite.Pattern); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, ck := range c.cookies {
+		if ck.Name == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("cookie name must not be empty")
+		}
+		if ck.TTL != nil && *ck.TTL != "" {
+			if _, err := parseCookieTTL(*ck.TTL); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+		for _, attr := range ck.Attributes {
+			if attr.Name == "" {
+				return fmt.Errorf("cookie attribute name must not be empty")
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, qp := range c.queryParameters {
+		if qp.Name == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("query parameter name must not be empty")
+		}
+	}
+	for _, fs := range c.filterState {
+		if fs.Key == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("filter state key must not be empty")
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func parseCookieTTL(ttl string) (*durationpb.Duration, error) {
+	ttl = strings.TrimSpace(ttl)
+	if ttl == "" {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+	if sec, err := strconv.ParseInt(ttl, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if sec < 0 {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl must be non-negative: %s", ttl)
+		}
+		return &durationpb.Duration{Seconds: sec}, nil
+	}
+	d, err := time.ParseDuration(ttl)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: %w", ttl, err)
+	}
+	if d < 0 {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl must be non-negative: %s", ttl)
+	}
+	return durationpb.New(d), nil
+}
+
+func deduplicateHeaders(headers []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader) []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader {
+	if len(headers) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(headers))
+	var result []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader
+	for _, h := range headers {
+		key := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+		if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[key] = struct{}{}
+		result = append(result, h)
+	}
+	return result
+}
+
+func deduplicateCookies(cookies []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie) []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie {
+	if len(cookies) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(cookies))
+	var result []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie
+	for _, c := range cookies {
+		if _, ok := seen[c.Name]; ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[c.Name] = struct{}{}
+		result = append(result, c)
+	}
+	return result
+}
+
+func deduplicateQueryParams(params []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter) []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter {
+	if len(params) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(params))
+	var result []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter
+	for _, qp := range params {
+		if _, ok := seen[qp.Name]; ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[qp.Name] = struct{}{}
+		result = append(result, qp)
+	}
+	return result
+}
+
+func deduplicateFilterState(filterState []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState) []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState {
+	if len(filterState) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(filterState))
+	var result []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState
+	for _, fs := range filterState {
+		if _, ok := seen[fs.Key]; ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[fs.Key] = struct{}{}
+		result = append(result, fs)
+	}
+	return result
+}
+
+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	ir := &consistentHashIR{
+		hasConsistentHash: true,
+	}
+	if spec.ConsistentHash.Disable != nil && *spec.ConsistentHash.Disable {
+		ir.disable = true
+	}
+	ir.headers = deduplicateHeaders(spec.ConsistentHash.Headers)
+	ir.cookies = deduplicateCookies(spec.ConsistentHash.Cookies)
+	ir.queryParameters = deduplicateQueryParams(spec.ConsistentHash.QueryParameters)
+	ir.filterState = deduplicateFilterState(spec.ConsistentHash.FilterState)
+	if spec.ConsistentHash.SourceIP != nil {
+		ir.sourceIP = &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{
+			Terminal: spec.ConsistentHash.SourceIP.Terminal,
+		}
+	}
+	out.consistentHash = ir
+}
+
+func (p *trafficPolicyPluginGwPass) handleConsistentHash(action *envoyroutev3.RouteAction, ir *consistentHashIR) {
+	if ir == nil || action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if ir.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+
+	action.HashPolicy = buildHashPolicies(ir)
+}
+
+func buildHashPolicies(ir *consistentHashIR) []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	hasSubFields := len(ir.headers) > 0 || len(ir.cookies) > 0 || len(ir.queryParameters) > 0 || len(ir.filterState) > 0 || ir.sourceIP != nil
+	if !hasSubFields {
+		return []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			{
+				Terminal: false,
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+					ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+						SourceIp: true,
+					},
+				},
+			},
+		}
+	}
+
+	var hashPolicies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	// 1. headers
+	headers := deduplicateHeaders(ir.headers)
+	for _, h := range headers {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: h.Terminal != nil && *h.Terminal,
+		}
+		headerSpec := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+			HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			headerSpec.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		hp.PolicySpecifier = &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+			Header: headerSpec,
+		}
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 2. cookies
+	cookies := deduplicateCookies(ir.cookies)
+	for _, c := range cookies {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: c.Terminal != nil && *c.Terminal,
+		}
+		cookieSpec := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: c.Name,
+		}
+		if c.Path != nil {
+			cookieSpec.Path = *c.Path
+		}
+		if c.TTL != nil && *c.TTL != "" {
+			if ttl, err := parseCookieTTL(*c.TTL); err == nil {
+				cookieSpec.Ttl = ttl
+			}
+		}
+		if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+			attrs := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, len(c.Attributes))
+			for i, a := range c.Attributes {
+				attrs[i] = &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+					Name:  a.Name,
+					Value: a.Value,
+				}
+			}
+			cookieSpec.Attributes = attrs
+		}
+		hp.PolicySpecifier = &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+			Cookie: cookieSpec,
+		}
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 3. queryParameters
+	queryParams := deduplicateQueryParams(ir.queryParameters)
+	for _, qp := range queryParams {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: qp.Terminal != nil && *qp.Terminal,
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: qp.Name,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 4. filterState
+	filterState := deduplicateFilterState(ir.filterState)
+	for _, fs := range filterState {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: fs.Terminal != nil && *fs.Terminal,
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: fs.Key,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 5. sourceIp
+	if ir.sourceIP != nil {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: ir.sourceIP.Terminal != nil && *ir.sourceIP.Terminal,
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, hp)
+	}
+
+	return hashPolicies
+}

+func cloneConsistentHash(in *consistentHashIR) *consistentHashIR {
+	if in == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	out := &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:           in.disable,
+		hasConsistentHash: in.hasConsistentHash,
+		headers:           slices.Clone(in.headers),
+		cookies:           slices.Clone(in.cookies),
+		queryParameters:   slices.Clone(in.queryParameters),
+		filterState:       slices.Clone(in.filterState),
+	}
+	if in.sourceIP != nil {
+		out.sourceIP = &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{
+			Terminal: in.sourceIP.Terminal,
+		}
+	}
+	return out

+func mergeConsistentHash(
+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	_ TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {
+	if p1 == nil || p2 == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if p1.spec.consistentHash == nil && p2.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if p1.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = cloneConsistentHash(p2.spec.consistentHash)
+		mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	if p2.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	// Determine higher and lower priority based on merge strategy
+	higher := p1.spec.consistentHash
+	lower := p2.spec.consistentHash
+	higherRef := (*ir.AttachedPolicyRef)(nil)
+	if opts.Strategy == policy.OverridableDeepMerge || opts.Strategy == policy.OverridableShallowMerge {
+		higher = p2.spec.consistentHash
+		lower = p1.spec.consistentHash
+		higherRef = p2Ref
+	}
+
+	// Requirement 2: When disable is true, no hash policies are produced
+	// and any inherited from broader-scoped policies are suppressed.
+	if higher.disable {
+		if opts.Strategy == policy.OverridableDeepMerge || opts.Strategy == policy.OverridableShallowMerge {
+			p1.spec.consistentHash = cloneConsistentHash(higher)
+			mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", higherRef, p2MergeOrigins)
+		} else {
+			p1.spec.consistentHash.headers = nil
+			p1.spec.consistentHash.cookies = nil
+			p1.spec.consistentHash.queryParameters = nil
+			p1.spec.consistentHash.filterState = nil
+			p1.spec.consistentHash.sourceIP = nil
+		}
+		return
+	}
+
+	// Requirement 7: When multiple TrafficPolicies target the same route, array fields must be
+	// unioned across both policies with the higher-priority policy's entries first, deduplicated by key.
+	// The merged result must be re-sorted into canonical type order.
+	// The sourceIp scalar retains the higher-priority policy's value even when unset.
+	mergedHeaders := deduplicateHeaders(append(slices.Clone(higher.headers), lower.headers...))
+	mergedCookies := deduplicateCookies(append(slices.Clone(higher.cookies), lower.cookies...))
+	mergedQueryParams := deduplicateQueryParams(append(slices.Clone(higher.queryParameters), lower.queryParameters...))
+	mergedFilterState := deduplicateFilterState(append(slices.Clone(higher.filterState), lower.filterState...))
+
+	var mergedSourceIP *kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP
+	if higher.sourceIP != nil {
+		mergedSourceIP = &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{
+			Terminal: higher.sourceIP.Terminal,
+		}
+	}
+
+	p1.spec.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:           false,
+		headers:           mergedHeaders,
+		cookies:           mergedCookies,
+		queryParameters:   mergedQueryParams,
+		filterState:       mergedFilterState,
+		sourceIP:          mergedSourceIP,
+		hasConsistentHash: true,
+	}
+
+	// Requirement 8: Merge metadata must record this field as consistentHash under the existing TrafficPolicy merge metadata key.
+	mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+}
